fullName: SBI Clerk — Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales), Clerical Cadre
overview: SBI Clerk is the State Bank of India's recruitment for **Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales)** in the clerical cadre: the branch-counter and customer-service staff of India's largest bank. It is a **State-wise recruitment**. You choose one State or Union Territory while applying, compete only for that State's vacancies, and must be proficient in that State's specified local language, which is tested (qualifying) before joining. There is **no interview**: a speed-based **Preliminary exam** (100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour with 20-minute sectional timing) screens candidates, and the **Main exam** (190 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours 40 minutes) alone decides the final state-wise, category-wise merit list. Prelims marks are not added to the merit. The syllabus overlaps heavily with IBPS Clerk (English, Quant, Reasoning, plus General/Financial Awareness and Computer Aptitude in Mains), so preparation for one largely covers the other. Earlier notifications used the job title 'Customer Service Associate'; the current advertisement says 'Customer Support & Sales'.

stages.name: Phase I — Preliminary Examination (screening)
stages.negative: 1 mark per correct answer, 1/4 mark deducted per wrong answer
stages.notes: Strict **20-minute sectional timing** for each of the three sections; you cannot move between sections. No minimum qualifying marks are prescribed for any individual test or for the aggregate, and section-wise marks are not maintained. About **10 times the vacancies** in each category (as decided by the Bank, subject to availability) are shortlisted for Mains in descending order of aggregate prelims marks. Numerical Ability and Reasoning Ability papers are available bilingually (English and the state's medium); English Language is in English only. **Prelims marks are not counted in the final merit.**

stages.name: Phase II — Main Examination (merit-deciding)
stages.notes: Each section carries its own timing (35 + 35 + 45 + 45 minutes) and cannot be swapped. Notice that **Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude carries 60 marks for 50 questions**, so the site's computer subject is tested inside this section rather than as a separate paper. You must score a minimum percentage on aggregate (as decided by the Bank, with 5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/XS/DXS candidates); no minimum for individual subjects. The final merit list is drawn from the **Mains aggregate only**, state-wise and category-wise. Trained Apprentices of SBI (engagement start date on or after 1 January 2022, one year of branch experience completed by 31 August 2026) get a bonus of 5 marks out of 200 (2.5% of maximum marks) added to the aggregate.

stages.name: Phase III — Local Language Proficiency Test (qualifying)
stages.mode: Written test at a centre of the State applied for
stages.notes: Provisionally selected candidates who did **not study the specified opted local language in Class 10 or 12** must take this test; those who can produce a 10th or 12th standard marksheet or certificate showing they studied the language are exempt. The test has a non-verbal part (objective, 15 questions, 15 marks, and subjective, 15 questions, 15 marks) and a verbal part (20 marks). You must score minimum qualifying marks decided by the Bank (5% relaxation for reserved categories). Candidates who fail are not offered appointment. The test is held at a centre of the State applied for, at the candidate's own expense.

eligibility.nationality: Eligible Indian Citizens (the advertisement's wording), as per the standard central recruitment clauses of the notice.

education.requirement: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University, or any equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government, as on **31 December 2026**. Final-year/semester students may apply provisionally but must produce proof of passing on or before 31 December 2026. Integrated dual degree (IDD) candidates must have the passing date on or before 31 December 2026.

Matriculate ex-servicemen who obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education (or the corresponding Navy/Air Force certificate) after at least 15 years of service in the Armed Forces are also eligible; the certificate must be dated on or before 31 December 2026.

eligibility.notes: Cumulative age relaxation is not available across categories. **Local language proficiency** (reading, writing, speaking and understanding) in the specified language of the State/UT applied for is essential and is tested before joining; a Class 10 or 12 marksheet showing the language exempts you from the test. OBC candidates need a non-creamy-layer certificate issued between 1 April 2026 and the date of joining. EWS candidates need the Income and Asset Certificate for FY 2025-26, valid for 2026-27. Serving or resigned SBI clerical-cadre employees are not eligible. Candidates against whom there is an adverse report on character and antecedents are not eligible.

selectionProcess: **Preliminary exam (screening) → Main exam (merit) → Local Language Proficiency Test (where applicable) → provisional selection → verification of eligibility → appointment.** Prelims marks are not added to the merit. The final merit list is drawn from the Mains aggregate, state-wise and category-wise, and selected candidates are posted in the State they applied for. There is **no interview**. A wait list of up to 50% of vacancies (state-category wise) is maintained for one year from the final result and is released quarterly against non-joining and resignation from the current batch only.
normalization: The advertisement does not mention any normalisation of scores across shifts. SBI prescribes **no minimum qualifying marks for individual prelims sections**; shortlisting for Mains (about 10 times the vacancies, category-wise) is done on the aggregate prelims score, and the merit list uses the Mains aggregate with a Bank-decided minimum on aggregate (5% relaxation for reserved categories). Do not compare raw scores with candidates of other shifts or states; the exact evaluation method, if any, is described only in the 'Acquaint Yourself' booklet issued with the call letter. Check the official notice for the final word.

faqs.q: Is there negative marking in SBI Clerk?
faqs.a: Yes. In both the Preliminary and Main exams, **1/4 of the mark assigned to a question is deducted for every wrong answer**. Unattempted questions carry no penalty.

faqs.q: What is the prelims and mains pattern?
faqs.a: **Prelims:** 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour — English Language 30, Numerical Ability 35, Reasoning Ability 35, each with 20-minute sectional timing. **Mains:** 190 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours 40 minutes — General/Financial Awareness 50 (35 min), General English 40 (35 min), Quantitative Aptitude 50 (45 min), Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude 50 questions for 60 marks (45 min).

faqs.q: Do prelims marks count in the final merit?
faqs.a: No. The preliminary exam only screens: about 10 times the vacancies in each category are shortlisted on prelims aggregate. The final merit list is built from the **Mains aggregate only**, state-wise and category-wise.

faqs.q: Is there any interview in SBI Clerk?
faqs.a: No. The selection process is the online prelims, the online mains and the test of the specified opted local language, followed by verification of eligibility. There is no interview or group discussion.

faqs.q: Who has to take the local language test?
faqs.a: Only provisionally selected candidates who did **not study the specified opted local language in Class 10 or 12**. If your 10th or 12th marksheet or certificate shows that you studied the language of the State you applied for, you are exempt. Candidates who fail the test are not offered appointment.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for SBI Clerk 2026?
faqs.a: **20 to 28 years as on 1 April 2026** (born not earlier than 2 April 1998 and not later than 1 April 2006), with relaxations: OBC +3, SC/ST +5, PwBD +10 to +15 depending on category, ex-servicemen as per service plus 3 years, and 7 years for widows, divorced and judicially separated women (not remarried).

faqs.q: What is the application fee and is it refunded?
faqs.a: **₹750 for General/OBC/EWS and Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/XS/DXS.** The fee is an intimation-plus-application charge and is **not refundable** on any account, unlike some railway exams where part of the fee comes back after appearing.

faqs.q: What is the SBI Clerk salary?
faqs.a: The starting basic pay is **₹26,730** (₹24,050 plus two advance increments for graduates) in the scale of ₹24,050 to ₹64,480. Total starting emoluments at a metro centre like Mumbai are around **₹46,000 per month** including DA and allowances at current rates, and they vary with the posting location. There is also PF, pension under the defined-contribution NPS, medical and leave-fare benefits.

faqs.q: Can I apply for vacancies of two States?
faqs.a: No. You may apply for vacancies of **one State/UT only** and can appear for the test only once under this recruitment project. Your candidature is considered only against the vacancies of the State/UT you opted for, and the merit list is state-wise, so choose your State carefully, factoring in the local language requirement.

faqs.q: Is there any bonus for SBI apprentices?
faqs.a: Yes. Trained Apprentices of SBI (engagement start date on or after 1 January 2022, with one year of specified branch experience completed by 31 August 2026 and satisfactory conduct and performance) get **5 bonus marks out of 200 (2.5%) in the Main exam**, plus a relaxation in the upper age limit of 1 to 6 years depending on category.

documents: For the application: recent **passport photograph** (4.5 x 3.5 cm, 20-50 kb; retain at least 8 copies of the same photo, it is needed at every stage), **scanned signature** (10-20 kb), **left thumb impression** (or the right thumb if needed) and the **hand-written declaration** in English. At the exam: the **prelims call letter** (get it authenticated at the centre and retain it for the mains), an original **photo ID** (passport, Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence, voter card, bank passbook with photo, or school/college ID) with a self-attested photocopy, and **two additional photographs** identical to the one on the call letter. At verification and joining: **Class 10 or 12 marksheet/certificate** proving study of the opted local language (if claiming exemption from the language test), **graduation marksheets and degree** (proof of passing needed by 31 December 2026), **category certificates** (SC/ST on the central government format; OBC non-creamy-layer certificate issued between 1 April 2026 and joining; EWS Income and Asset Certificate for FY 2025-26, valid for 2026-27), **PwBD disability certificate** issued by the competent authority, and **ex-servicemen documents** (discharge book, or Proforma B/C/D for serving personnel) where applicable. SBI may capture thumb impression or IRIS biometrics at various stages, so keep your hands free of mehendi, ink or chemicals.
